summary: Infrastructure and Platform-focused Senior Engineer with 4+ years building and operating resilient, high-availability systems across Linux, Docker, and Kubernetes. Designed GitLab CI/CD pipelines deploying to self-managed Kubernetes clusters, configured OpenTelemetry distributed tracing and Grafana alerting, and managed AWS cloud infrastructure. Eliminated message loss under peak load by introducing Apache Kafka and scaled services over 6M-row datasets with deep focus on reliability, fault tolerance, and developer tooling automation.

jobs.blurb: Consumer-lending platform with 9K+ new leads a day. Cross-functional product team; contract engagement via GIDFINANCE.
bullets: Designed and built the delivery and observability stack the engineering team ships on: **GitLab CI/CD into a 5-node self-managed Kubernetes cluster**, **OpenTelemetry** distributed tracing, and **Grafana** alerting.
**Eliminated notification loss** under peak traffic bursts by migrating notification delivery and domain-event processing to **Apache Kafka**, ensuring fault-tolerant, replayable event streaming.

Cut query execution time on a 100K-row lead-scoring dataset (9K+ new leads/day) from **8 s to under 1 s** through deep database profiling, server-side pagination, and PostgreSQL query and index optimization.

Automated delivery and DX across the team: authored **project rules for Claude Code** (architecture conventions, guardrails) and built **custom MCP servers** exposing database schemas and documentation, cutting CRUD module delivery from **~2 h to ~40 min**.

Led a 3-engineer team to launch a credit-report product that **turned profitable in week one** (net profit **+40%**, EPC doubled from **~$1.9 to ~$3.8**) by owning technical design, system architecture, and Node.js backend over a **6M-row** dataset.

jobs.blurb: Mobile-app marketing platform: ~100 employees, 10,000+ apps promoted for clients in 26 countries.
bullets: Made **100% of payouts auditable** and screened out fraudulent completions by modeling the full task lifecycle behind an asynchronous moderation queue with anti-fraud rules, processing **hundreds of completions a day**.

Scaled the task-and-rewards platform to **1,000 daily active users in 3 months**, delivering resilient user workflows, automated re-engagement notifications, and real-time administrative verification queues.

jobs.blurb: Lead-generation agency for residential developers and law firms (~60 employees). Owned client-server architecture, APIs, and infrastructure.
bullets: Decomposed a legacy PHP monolith into containerized **Node.js/TypeScript microservices** (Express, PostgreSQL), migrating core business logic and establishing isolated services with automated deployments.
**Cut LLM API infrastructure costs 10×** by designing a confidence-based model cascade: a lightweight model processes routine requests and escalates to a heavy model only when confidence drops.

**Tripled monthly channel revenue from ~$47K to ~$141K** and slashed lead response time from ~8 min to **under 30 s** by delivering an automated AI processing assistant with real-time customer communication.
